review_candidates.title: Network Operations Center Technician
review_candidates.description: Company Description TengoInternet provides wireless network consulting, design, implementation, and management services to customers across the United States. For over 24 years, the company has focused on helping clients deliver reliable, guest-pleasing connectivity through purpose-built outdoor WiFi networks. TengoInternet’s mission is to keep people connected for work, entertainment, and communication, even in demanding environments. The team specializes in designing and supporting networks that perform well in challenging terrains and extreme weather conditions. Applicants join a company committed to guaranteed outdoor connectivity solutions and long-term customer success. Role Description The Network Operations Center (NOC) Technician is a full-time, remote role responsible for monitoring and supporting TengoInternet’s wireless networks. Day-to-day tasks include actively observing network performance, responding to alerts, and identifying issues that may impact service quality. The technician will troubleshoot and resolve network incidents, provide technical support to clients and internal teams, and escalate complex problems when needed. The role involves performing routine maintenance, documenting findings and resolutions, and following standardized procedures to ensure reliable, high-quality connectivity. The NOC Technician collaborates with other network and support professionals to maintain uptime, improve network reliability, and enhance the overall user experience. Qualifications Experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC) environment, including monitoring network health and responding to alerts. Strong skills in Network Administration and Computer Network Operations, with familiarity in managing routers, switches, access points, and related infrastructure. Demonstrated ability in Technical Support and Troubleshooting, including diagnosing connectivity issues and resolving incidents efficiently. Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, WiFi technologies, and common network monitoring tools. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple tasks, and follow documented processes and runbooks. Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Network+, CCNA, or equivalent experience are preferred. Availability to work scheduled shifts, which may include evenings, nights, weekends, or holidays as operational needs require.

review_candidates.title: Information Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Gallagher Our purpose at Gallagher is ‘Protect what matters most’ and we live it every day, whether that’s protecting the world’s highest security environments or agricultural businesses, we care deeply about our people, their families, and our wider communities. Gallagher Security is on a mission to unlock more value for our customers through the power of our people and solutions - and right now is a pivotal moment in our evolution. We’re scaling with intent, driving an incredible growth trajectory with innovation and customer impact at the heart of everything we do. With operations across New Zealand, Australia, Asia, Africa, the USA, Canada, and Europe and exports to over 140 countries we’re building globally focused career pathways right here in New Zealand. As we expand our Hamilton-based teams, this is your chance to be part of a true Kiwi tech success story making a global impact. If you’re driven by passion and purpose to protect what matters most, come help shape the future of what’s possible with us. The Opportunity We're looking for an Information Security Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team. Reporting to the Information Security Manager and working closely with the Cybersecurity Operations Lead, you'll play a hands-on role in strengthening Gallagher's security capabilities across security platforms, cloud environments, applications, and DevSecOps practices. This is a broad engineering role that offers the opportunity to work across multiple domains of cybersecurity. You'll help implement and maintain security controls, support vulnerability remediation, contribute to automation initiatives, and work alongside technical teams to ensure our environments remain secure, reliable, and resilient. You'll be responsible for Configuring, maintaining, and optimising security platforms including SIEM, EDR, IAM, CASB, vulnerability management tools, and firewalls Supporting cloud and application security initiatives, including identity and access management and conditional access controls Assisting with the remediation of security vulnerabilities across applications, platforms, and cloud environments Developing scripts and automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort across security operations Supporting security testing programs, including validation and remediation activities associated with SAST and DAST findings Collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and security teams to strengthen Gallagher's overall security posture About You You're a curious and proactive security professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and continuously learning. Comfortable working across multiple areas of cybersecurity, you're equally at home configuring security platforms, supporting cloud security initiatives, and automating repetitive tasks. You'll Also Bring 3 to 5 years' experience in cybersecurity, information security, or IT engineering roles Experience configuring or supporting security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, IAM, CASB, vulnerability management tools, or firewalls Exposure to cloud environments and application security concepts Scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams A tertiary qualification in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience Working at Gallagher You’ll be part of a global, future-focused organisation where creativity and innovation are valued and supported. Working in an environment driven by collaboration, innovation, passion, craftsmanship and mutual respect, you’ll help achieve our team purpose to translate vision into exceptional creations. We Also Offer Competitive salary and bonuses Hybrid flexibility (typically 3 days in the office a week, with additional onsite days required depending on work demands) KiwiSaver on-top and Life and Disability insurance Mentorship and professional development opportunities A supportive team culture with team-building events, and a fun environment Growth at Gallagher is constant, and we are building our team with like-minded individuals who relate to our story so that together we can continue to push the boundaries of what is possible. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the role may be filled before the closing date.

review_candidates.description: Randstad Professional ist eine der vier Spezialisierungen von Randstad und konzentriert sich auf die Vermittlung von Fach- und Führungskräften in den Zukunftsbranchen IT, Engineering, Life Science und Office. For our client, a leading company in the energy sector, we are looking for an Incident Response Expert (m/w/d). Project content is an immediate, short-term initiative within our customer's AI threat resilience strategy. The purpose is to buy time by increasing detection, response, containment and recovery readiness while a broader Phase 2 plan is prepared for the rest of the Business IT units. Key Details Start Date: 21.09.2026 - 31.03.2027 Workload: 100% (40 hours/week) Location: 100% remote Projekt Language: English Conceptual development and structured implementation of the immediate incident response workstream, focused on AI-augmented attacks that may progress at machine speed. Creation of practical response playbooks and SOPs for identity compromise, cloud control-plane abuse, endpoint intrusion, lateral movement, ransomware-style disruption and data-impact scenarios. Definition of decision points for containment, escalation, evidence preservation, communication, legal/regulatory handover and crisis coordination. Provision of technical consultation and recommendations to SOC, threat intelligence, security monitoring, infrastructure, application, Azure, on-premise and resilience teams. Establishment and technical definition of a repeatable operating model for response readiness, evidence collection, handover and post-incident improvement before end of Q1 2027. Provision of technical consultation to enable fast, consistent and controlled response to AI-assisted cyber incidents across hybrid Azure and on-premise landscapes. Predefinition and documentation of roles, triggers, containment options, and communication paths to optimize incident response workflows Development of guidelines to facilitate responder action when critical thresholds are reached. Conversion of lessons from exercises and response reviews into improved playbooks, SOPs and control requirements. Technical preparation of scenario walkthroughs for validation by SOC, Cyber Defense, legal/compliance, cloud, infrastructure and resilience stakeholders. Assessment of exercise results against time-to-triage, time-to-contain, decision latency and handover quality. Usability testing of playbooks by responders who did not author them. Creation of a Management-ready dashboard for readiness gaps, residual risks and agreed next actions. Identification and technical gap analysis of existing processes (too slow, fragmented, undocumented or dependent on informal knowledge) to document optimization potential. Transformation of risk discussion Transformation of risk evaluations into executable playbooks, technical control frameworks, test protocols, backlog items and management evidence. Provision of a structured handover of a Phase 2 backlog and recommendations for the broader Business IT resilience plan after Q1 2027. Creation of comprehensive documentation with all results regarding the above-mentioned tasks with subsequent handover to our customer for review and approval for further usage. Minimum 8 years in incident response, cyber defense operations, crisis management, digital forensics or security operations leadership Hands-on experience responding to identity compromise, ransomware, cloud compromise, endpoint intrusion and lateral movement incidents Strong understanding of Microsoft security stack, Azure/Entra ID response actions, EDR isolation, forensic triage and evidence preservation Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional technical and management stakeholders during high-pressure situations Relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, CISSP, CISM, SC-200, AZ-500 or equivalent are beneficial

review_candidates.description: About Nscale Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility. At Nscale, our AI Infrastructure team plays a critical role in building and operating the high-performance network infrastructure that connects our GPU cloud platform, data centres, customers, and global partners. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future. About The Role We are hiring a Staff Network Backbone & Edge Engineer to help design, deploy, operate, and maintain Nscale's backbone and edge infrastructure — the carrier-grade transport layer connecting our GPU compute facilities with enterprise customers across our global network. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role with ownership spanning inter-site transport, WAN edge routing, wavelength services, Internet transit, public and private peering, and carrier circuit delivery. You'll work as part of our regional network team and act as a subject matter expert across backbone and edge technologies. You'll be equally comfortable commissioning a new backbone node, troubleshooting complex BGP routing issues, responding to service incidents, validating optical connectivity, and working directly with carriers on circuit delivery and technical escalations. This role is ideal for an experienced network engineer who enjoys operating across the full networking stack — from the physical and optical layers through WAN transport and Internet edge. What you'll be doing Backbone & Network Edge Deploy, configure, and maintain Nokia SR Series routers across Nscale's backbone and edge network. Configure and operate BGP peering, IP/MPLS, VRFs, IPv6, routing policies, and traffic engineering. Commission and test 400G/800G wavelength services between backbone nodes. Coordinate with carriers and colocation teams on circuit delivery, optical acceptance testing, and service validation. Manage IP transit and peering configurations at edge locations, ensuring appropriate capacity and consistent customer performance. Maintain BGP community policies, AS management, prefix announcements, and DDoS mitigation configurations across regional edge nodes. Optical & Physical Infrastructure Accept and validate wavelength services at carrier demarcation points. Conduct optical power budget analysis, OTDR testing, and end-to-end circuit verification. Manage intra-site fibre infrastructure, optical patching, and interface connectivity at backbone colocation sites. Coordinate with colocation providers on cross-connect delivery and physical infrastructure for backbone deployments. Maintain accurate physical-layer documentation, including fibre records, optical test results, and as-built documentation. Testing & Validation Execute structured test plans for backbone node commissioning, circuit delivery, and service activation. Perform optical, IP-layer, and end-to-end service validation. Conduct regression and smoke testing following maintenance windows, software upgrades, and configuration changes. Develop and maintain standardised test plans and acceptance criteria for backbone infrastructure. Document test results, acceptance sign-offs, and validation records in line with Nscale's operational standards. Network Operations & Reliability Monitor backbone performance using network management, observability, and telemetry tooling. Proactively identify and resolve network degradation, capacity constraints, and routing anomalies. Act as a Tier 3+ escalation point for complex backbone and WAN edge incidents. Support incident response and troubleshooting across backbone and connectivity services. Manage scheduled maintenance, capacity audits, and preventive maintenance across regional backbone infrastructure. Carrier & Supplier Engagement Own technical relationships with wavelength providers, colocation partners, and IP transit carriers. Coordinate circuit delivery, activation, performance management, and technical escalations. Work directly with carrier engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve complex service issues. Support carrier procurement activities by providing technical input into RFQs, circuit specifications, capacity requirements, and supplier evaluations. About You Required Experience 5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, with a focus on backbone, Internet edge, WAN, or transport infrastructure. Proven experience working with Nokia SR routing platforms. Strong hands-on knowledge of BGP, traffic engineering, service segmentation, IP transit, and Internet edge architecture. Experience working within carrier-grade, hyperscale, cloud, ISP, or large-scale data centre network environments. Experience working directly with carriers and colocation providers on circuit delivery and technical escalations. Ability to operate independently across technical domains spanning the physical layer, optical transport, WAN, and Internet edge. Optical & Transport Expertise Hands-on experience with 400G/800G coherent optical transport and wavelength services. Experience conducting optical acceptance testing and link budget analysis. Proficiency with optical testing equipment, including OTDRs, optical power meters, and optical spectrum analysers. Strong understanding of fibre infrastructure, cross-connects, wavelength services, and carrier demarcation. Networking & Automation Strong understanding of BGP, IP/MPLS, IPv6, VRFs, routing policy, traffic engineering, and DDoS mitigation. Familiarity with network automation tooling such as Python, Ansible, and Terraform. Experience with network monitoring, telemetry, and observability platforms. Comfortable working in Linux environments and using Git-based workflows. Preferred Experience Regional carrier ecosystem knowledge across EMEA. Experience working within hyperscale, cloud, telecommunications, ISP, or AI infrastructure environments. Experience supporting high-capacity backbone networks and mission-critical connectivity. Exposure to automated network provisioning and Network-as-Code practices. Personal Attributes Deeply technical and comfortable remaining hands-on. Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills. Calm and methodical when responding to complex incidents. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Comfortable working independently while collaborating across global teams. Excellent communication skills when working with engineering teams, carriers, vendors, and internal stakeholders. Curious and motivated to continuously improve network performance, reliability, and operational practices. What we can offer you At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core. Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months. 🚀 Join one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies — your opportunity to build and operate the high-capacity network infrastructure connecting the next generation of AI. ✨ Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by taking ownership of critical network infrastructure, solving complex engineering challenges, and helping scale Nscale's global backbone and edge network. Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
